x: In the Junior match Jimmy Rae was second in the 100 yards, while Dave Marshall occupied the same position in the 220 yards. Alan Picton won the 440 yards, and this seems to be his best distance, but our team lost the 4 x 110 yards relay.

In the Senior 4 x 110 yds. we had Mike Broadbent, Gordon Lowers, Basil Walden and Jimmy Rae running for us and although we had the lead at the last change-over, Rae had to give best to Clay Gibbs, the coloured
4 x 110 yards · Marshall, Tebbutt, Rae, Sexton. · July, 1949 · 43.5
4 x 110 yds · Marshall, Tebbutt, Rae, Sexton · July 1949 · 43.5

Sexton won his heat in 24.1; Tebbutt won his heat in 24.6; Picton, Marshall and Rae were each second in their heats. Sexton beat Marshall in the second round in 23.6; Picton won his second round in 23.9.
